description: For input index \(a\), approximation \(h\), stage \(s\), and state \(z\), the successor Sacks state tabulates both finite sides below \(s+1\) and both updated record lists at priorities \(q\le s\). On those finite side positions, it retains old membership and inserts the fresh scheduler arrival into the chosen side when a fresh arrival exists. It stores the updated records even at idle stages.
